name: Colorado Department of Agriculture
collect_note: Reads the first page of the Colorado Department of Agriculture press releases twice a day and keeps releases about agrivoltaics grants or funding, so the next round of the Agrivoltaics Research and Demonstration Grant shows up as a dated call. Nothing is open today; the 2026-27 window closed June 15, 2026.

zero_reason.quote: Application window for Fiscal Year 2026-27 closed on June 15, 2026.

evidence: Checked 2026-11-12 with the grants-recon user agent (a bare Mozilla/5.0 agent gets HTTP 403 from the site CDN). endpoint_recon.py --no-chrome: html_ok, 8885 chars, no opportunity endpoint, rejected_candidates empty. Channels: Grants.gov search2 keyword agrivoltaics: 0 hits (state program, not federal). Feeds: /rss.xml, /feed, /rss, /category/press-release/feed all 404; no link rel=alternate. Site JSON: /jsonapi 404, /jsonapi/node/article 404, /api/press 404, no __NEXT_DATA__, no ld+json. Portals: none, applications go by email. Sitemap.xml 200 (1598 urls) lists the agrivoltaics press releases and webinar events, no calls listing. /events has no static items. Chosen: press release listing https://ag.colorado.gov/category/press-release HTTP 200, 10 teasers per page, filter agrivolt plus grant words. Filter replayed on archived pages: ?page=13 gives 'Agrivoltaics Research and Demonstration Grant Now Open' deadline 2025-05-30, ?page=21 same title deadline 2024-07-21, ?page=26 'Grants Available for Projects Showcasing Agrivoltaics in Colorado' deadline 2023-10-27, ?page=10 'Colorado Continues to Lead' correctly excluded. Page 0 today: 0 items. Weakness: the FY2026-27 round has no press release in the listing (only webinar events), so a future round may appear only on the program page.
